evidence.quote: You check and the dealer checks behind. The flop is J♦ 10♣ 3♦

evidence.quote: so we go to showdown. The dealer's Q♣ Q♦ with the J♦ 10♣ 5♠ on the board makes a pair of queens.
The turn is the 2♣, a blank

criteria.why: The Croupier deals every street, plays the dealer's actions, reveals the dealer's hand at showdown and settles the pot itself. The player only makes their own choices.
